findings.text: GPT-6 Astra has the best composite score across all three jobs, at $1.42 per lot for a full takeoff. GPT-6.1 Sol (0.742, $0.27) and Gemini 4 Argon on its 0-1000 grid (0.723, $0.18, fastest) are the cheaper frontier.
No system beats GPT-6 Astra on lot outlines, but Gemini 4 Argon ties it at 28% of the cost when it thinks longer, gets one geometry rule and one retry. It takes about twice as long.
Gemini 4 Argon counts stalls best when asked for coordinates on its native 0-1000 grid: 7.4% mean error against 12.2% for GPT-6 Astra, at about one eighth of the cost.
